short_release_notes:
Build 100 adds bounded per-channel KA9Q forward-progress recovery and retains coverage-driven SDR acquisition with server-only canonical matching. It repairs receiver reconstruction, binds evidence to the current receiver generation, and preserves reachable server refusal diagnostics while keeping reporting fail-closed.

Managed ARM64 update only. KA9Q and SDRplay versions, receiver coverage, multicast and RF behavior remain pinned. Hardware fault recovery is source-qualified and requires controlled device qualification after managed activation. The separate owner-web application is not replaced by this package.
